newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada court appoints receiver for Consumers.
newsitem.headline: Canada court appoints receiver for Consumers.

text.p: Consumers Distributing Inc said on Friday that an Ontario court granted a petition by the company's bankers to push the struggling retailer into bankruptcy.

Consumers said in a statement the Ontario Court of Justice (General Division) today issued a receiving order against the company. The banking syndicate has appointed Coopers & Lybrand to act as receiver.
The 216-store retailer, which is struggling under a C$250 million debt load, sought protection from its creditors on July 29 as it worked on a restructuring plan.

"It became apparent that even when we were successful in finding investors prepared to put funds into the company, it would not be possible to develop a restructuring plan that would salvage any value for the company's unsecured creditors," said Perry Caicco, who resigned as president and chief executive officer of the company today.
